rounds.text: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at an attractive P/E ratio of just 20.3x [E1] despite phenomenal historical growth, including a 5-year compounded sales growth of 584% [E8] and a 3-year profit growth of 89% [E11]. The business displays elite operational efficiency with a ROCE of 33.8% [E6] and an ROE of 26.0% [E7], vastly outperforming the sector median ROCE of 9.9% [E64]. Fundamental momentum remains exceptionally strong, backed by a robust consumer tailwind in the Consumer Durables sector [E61] and management guidance targeting a revenue CAGR of approximately 35% alongside at least 20 new store additions in FY27 [E65, E66]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow calculation indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 1206 per share against the current market price of Rs 610 [E33], leaving a substantial margin of safety of 49.4% [E34]. Conceded: the stock is currently lagging the broader market with an RS rating of 0, sitting near its 52-week low [E5, E39, E57].
